name: frank-ai-researcher
description: Remote MCP server for Frank, which runs AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers in 50+ languages. Create and publish interview studies, then read transcripts and themes. Also available as an app in ChatGPT. Requires a Frank account (free plan available); sign-in is OAuth.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint with OAuth sign-in

tools.name: create_research
tools.description: Create a new interview study with goals and questions (always a draft)

tools.name: get_research
tools.description: Read a study and its full interview guide

tools.name: edit_research
tools.description: Edit a study's setup, topics and questions

tools.name: publish_research
tools.description: Publish a study and get its interviewer link

tools.name: link_product
tools.description: Attach a product to a study

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Create a product for studies to reference

tools.name: list_researches
tools.description: List studies, newest first, with status and interviewer link

tools.name: list_interviews
tools.description: List a study's interviews with status and completion

tools.name: list_embeds
tools.description: List website-widget formats for a study

tools.name: get_embed
tools.description: Get one widget's settings and install snippet

examples.title: Create a study
examples.prompt: Create a Frank study to interview churned customers about why they cancelled.

examples.title: Read interviews
examples.prompt: List the completed interviews in my latest Frank study and summarize the main themes.
